text.p: Prime Minister John Major is to stage a press conference in Penzance at 0815 GMT as he takes to the election campaign trail in western England.
His deputy prime minister, Michael Heseltine, is campaigning in London while Chancellor of the Exchequer Kenneth Clarke will be in Wales.
The opposition Labour Party is concentrating on education with its leader Tony Blair due to speak on the issue when campaigning in Birmingham.
Labour's education spokesman David Blunkett and finance spokesman Gordon Brown are staging a 0730 GMT press conference in London with the theme: "Failing The Test: The Tories' record on education."
Former Oscar-winning actress Glenda Jackson, now a transport spokeswoman for Labour, is staging an 0900 GMT press conference in London for the international media.
